title: Final Condition
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the stability condition f(r) > - (r/3) (df/dr)|_r.

title: Use of Angular Momentum
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the conservation of angular momentum in their derivation.

title: Force Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the equation m*ddot{r} = -f + m*r*dot{theta}^2 accurately.

title: Small Displacements
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly introduce small displacements delta r and delta theta in their analysis.

title: Sign of Coefficient
description: Essential Criteria: The student must identify that the coefficient of delta r must be negative for stability.

title: Common Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes when applying the stability condition.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all terms in their equations have consistent units.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or special scenarios to reinforce their solution.
